source: generated from storyboard/cat-check.storyboard.json (rev round-3) by cues-from-storyboard.mjs; lines and anchors are the storyboard's own shots[].vo, shifted onto the delivered timeline (poster card 2.000 s in front, end card 2.000 s at the back)

sections.name: preroll
sections.note: the 2.000 s poster card: the pad and the logo mnemonic only. No kick, no bass, no hats, no plucks; the first hit is on the cut out of the card

sections.name: lift
sections.note: plucks up an octave, FM index down, shimmer in

sections.name: out
sections.note: single hit, then ring out under the end card, which now holds the spoken close

swells.note: reverse swell into the lift and the end card

bed.padNote: the sustained band-limited chord, voiced two and three octaves above the plucks so it lives in 1-4 kHz - the band a voice rest sounds empty in - without touching the 20-200 Hz anti-engine band.

lines.text: Check is where you let the machine look at what a person cannot, on the page you are on.
Check accessibility lists what would stop somebody using this page at all.
With a screen reader, with a keyboard alone, or with the colours it uses.
It runs the same engine Chrome DevTools uses, rule by rule.
Press a finding and the page scrolls it into view and rings it.
The panel adds a full rule list and twelve checks a machine cannot make.
Check page speed measures how fast this page really drew and answered.
Logged in, mid-flow, on your real network, with every request it made.
It reads the page as it is right now, not as it loads cold.
That is the number Lighthouse cannot give you, because it never signs in.
The slow page is usually the one behind the login, and this one is.
Check the links finds every link on the page and asks each one.
Whether it still answers, and how long it took to say so.
Broken, redirected, slow, or fine, split four ways on the card.
It runs from the extension, so links out to other sites are tested too.
Dead links are the bug every visitor finds and no tester logs.
Measure code coverage shows which of this page's own JavaScript actually ran.
Ready on the card says in advance whether this page can be measured.
Chrome puts a bar across the top while it runs. That is expected.
It comes off the moment you stop, and nothing is attached until you start.
lines.why: all five draws of "It comes off the moment you stop, and nothing is attached until you start." ended +2.6 to +14.9 ST against a +1.0 ST ceiling. Two draws were within 3 ST, so the spread is worth a second set.

lines.text: Function by function, it shows the code your test never reached.
Check the fine print reads the legal surface of the page.
Policies, consent, trackers, and whether there is a real business behind it.
Was consent asked before anything was stored, and who else did the page call.
Nine of the nineteen worries on a legal checklist are properties of the page.
The four no browser can answer are filed as questions, not ticked.
Five machines looking, and all five findings land in one report.
QA Wrap. Every failure, traced.
lines.delivery: warm, unhurried, final. Not a sell
lines.why: all five draws of the close, "QA Wrap. Every failure, traced.", ended +5.9 to +13.8 ST. The same six words landed first time on all nine other films, so this one is the lottery the draw gate exists for, not the wording.

voice.note: The commercial's final recipe: one Gemini request per line, one voice and one delivery instruction, the gate selecting by shot fit among contour-passing draws, the clean chain with a +6 dB bell at 3.9 kHz whose gain is inside the voice trim.
